references.text: Jesus' prayer that many will believe is fulfilled immediately when those who have seen signs believe in him.
The crowd follows Jesus and sees Lazarus, which leads more to believe, but also causes them to plan to kill Lazarus.
Jesus' first sign at Cana leads the disciples to believe in him, paralleling how signs in Jerusalem lead many to believe.
A father believes in Jesus after seeing a sign, just as the Jewish visitors believe after seeing Lazarus' resurrection.
Many believe in Jesus near the temple, a theme repeated when many Jews believe after seeing Lazarus.
People wonder whether the Messiah can perform more signs than this man did, and many believe in him because of signs.
